Banana oat oil biscuits

Tej- és tojásmentes keksz

7 months+ Adjusted 20 min 10 portions

Offer one soft piece as a texture to practise on, alongside an iron-rich meal. They should bend, not snap.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 large Ripe banana (Mashed smooth)
  • 100 g Rolled oats (Fine oats give a softer bake)
  • 1 tablespoon Mild oil (Rapeseed or sunflower)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mash the banana and stir in the oats and oil.
  3. Press small thick rounds onto a lined tray.
  4. Bake until just set and still soft, about 12 minutes.
  5. Cool on the tray and keep them covered so they do not dry hard.

Adjusted

Shop baby biscuits are unnecessary and often sweet. These biscuits are a texture, not an iron food.

Bake soft biscuits from banana, oats, and oil. Use no sugar and no honey.
